snippet.title: Tomb of the Bloodletter - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Tomb of the Bloodletter is an upcoming word-game roguelike, which challenges you to create deadly spells out of words. 

Store page with demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3531630/Tomb_of_the_Bloodletter/?beta=0
